classification: candidate formalization design; no source admission or world-truth proof
independence: Mathematical denotation specified independently from a Boolean checker; tests of a handwritten evaluator do not prove source fidelity or universal evaluator correctness.

information_states.absent: No value exists under the selected representation meaning; not historical nonexistence by default.
information_states.execution-unknown: timeout/unsupported/missing provider; not a third logical truth value.
information_states.false: The exact complete model makes the proposition false.
information_states.known: Exact supplied or established record value with evidence posture.
information_states.unknown: Needed information is unavailable; no inference of falsehood.

population_policy.required_inhabitants: declared independently and checked together in one combined model
population_policy.sort_domains: nonempty in this core; alternate domain policy is an explicit profile extension

satisfaction.equality: Both interpreted terms denote the same element in the common carrier.
satisfaction.exists: some assignment from the quantified sort domain satisfies the body
satisfaction.forall: all assignments from the quantified sort domain satisfy the body
satisfaction.predicate: Evaluate terms then test tuple membership in that predicate interpretation.

structure.environment: Map each bound variable to an element of its declared sort.
structure.typedness: Every interpretation follows exact signature and carrier identity.

truth_logic: Classical two-valued logic for complete well-typed interpretations; a non-run/malformed/unsupported result is outside truth evaluation.

world_policy.closed_world: only exact declared complete enumerations/closed records
world_policy.default: open with respect to incomplete source/evidence records
world_policy.unknown_values: Explicit domain/data representation if needed; not overloaded with logical false
